item.title: Write the Cleanup Headline

turns.text: Make a square social graphic encouraging people to help clean up their local beach. Friendly illustrated seaside scene, with a short catchy headline — you pick the words. No dates or signup details.

item.tests: Checks that the agent writes and renders a suitable headline rather than asking the user for wording or omitting text.

answer_sheet.Headline language and purpose: English; encourage people to help clean up their local beach.
answer_sheet.Size or platform: Square social graphic; no particular platform.
answer_sheet.Event details or additional copy: No dates or signup details; no event information needs to be invented.

must_haves: One square finished social graphic is delivered.
A short, readable English headline encourages beach cleanup or keeping beaches clean.
The headline is embedded in the image, not merely supplied in the chat response.
The illustration visibly depicts a beach and a cleanup activity, such as collecting litter.
No dates or signup details appear.

turns.text: Could you make a social graphic encouraging people to help clean up their local beach? I like the idea of giving people a little nudge to care for the coast, because it can feel like a small thing that actually matters. For the scene, I’m thinking a friendly seaside illustration, and the graphic should be square. It should have a short, catchy headline, but I’m happy for you to pick the words. I always overthink wording on things like this, so handing that part over is a relief. Please don’t include any dates or signup details.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the graphic because your Magic Hour account doesn’t have enough credits. No image was created.

**Supporting line:** Pick up a little. Help a lot.

**Visual:** A square, friendly seaside illustration in seafoam green, ocean blue, sandy cream, and sunny coral, showing neighbors picking up litter beside gentle waves and dune grasses. No dates or signup details.

approvals.name: generate_image

args.name: Small Acts, Cleaner Coasts — Beach Cleanup Social Graphic

style.prompt: Create a polished square social media graphic encouraging people to help clean up their local beach. Friendly contemporary seaside illustration, warm and welcoming editorial style, soft paper texture, clean shapes, seafoam green, ocean blue, sandy cream and sunny coral palette. A few friendly adult neighbors casually collecting small pieces of litter along a beautiful local beach, using a reusable collection bag and litter grabber. Gentle waves, dune grasses, a small seabird, sunshine; emphasize care, community, and the hopeful impact of small actions, not guilt or a heavily polluted landscape. Strong readable hierarchy and balanced composition, generous margins. In the upper third place the exact short catchy headline in large beautiful bold clearly legible typography: 'Small acts. Cleaner coasts.' Under it place the exact smaller supporting line: 'Pick up a little. Help a lot.' Keep typography high contrast against a simple light cream sky, with the seaside illustration filling the lower two thirds. Professional cohesive graphic design, immediately readable on a phone. No other text, no dates, no signup details, no logos, no watermark.
